prompt:
You are generating a minimal, working TypeScript/Node scaffold for AutoResearch, a multi‑agent research app that interviews the user, plans sources/queries, calls specialist adapters (PubMed, arXiv, Wolfram|Alpha), screens results, compares evidence, and produces a cited report.

Output rules (very important)
Return code only as a sequence of file blocks.

Each file must be wrapped like:

cpp
Copy
Edit
`ts
// path: <relative/path/filename.ext>
// <code here>
markdown
Copy
Edit
Use the **correct language fence** (`ts`, `json`, `md`, `sh`) for syntax highlighting.
No placeholders like “…”. Provide complete, runnable files.

No explanations outside code blocks.

Keep internal reasoning private; output only code and brief top‑of‑file comments.

Requirements
1) Project shape
Create these files:

package.json (scripts: dev, build, start, test)

tsconfig.json

.env.example (WOLFRAM_APPID, PORT, OPENALEX_EMAIL optional)

README.md (quick start & curl examples)

src/server.ts (Express + CORS + JSON + routes, loads env)

src/routes.ts (mount REST endpoints)

src/lib/http.ts (fetch wrapper with retry/backoff, rate‑limit helpers)

src/spec/schemas.ts
Types: ResearchBrief, Capability, ExecutionPlan, ActionStep, RecordLite, Evidence, ComparisonTable

src/spec/prompts.ts
Export editable strings for:

INTERVIEW_PROMPT

ORCHESTRATOR_PROMPT

PUBMED_QUERY_BUILDER_PROMPT

WOLFRAM_INPUT_BUILDER_PROMPT

SCREENING_PROMPT

SYNTHESIS_PROMPT

src/agents/interview.ts (validate to ResearchBrief with Zod; stub uses a passed‑in LLM client)

src/agents/orchestrator.ts (build ExecutionPlan, emit ActionStep[], selection heuristics)

src/agents/screening.ts (title/abstract/full‑text rule application)

src/agents/quant.ts (deterministic metrics: recency, citations log, sample size normalisation)

src/agents/qual.ts (LLM helper for bias/method ratings)

src/agents/synthesis.ts (comparison table + markdown report)

src/adapters/pubmed.ts (ESearch/ESummary/EFetch; history paging)

src/adapters/arxiv.ts (Atom API query; 3‑second courtesy delay)

src/adapters/wolfram.ts (Full Results API ?input=...&output=json)

src/adapters/openalex.ts (optional metadata enrichment for citations)

src/dispatcher.ts (runs ActionSteps; SSE stream to client)

src/types/llm.ts (LLM interface with generateJSON<T>() util)

src/config/capabilities.ts (list of Capability for enabled sources)

test/plan.spec.ts (vitest: validates the plan structure)

test/smoke.spec.ts (vitest: runs a short end‑to‑end with mocked adapters)

2) REST endpoints
Implement in routes.ts:

POST /api/interview/finalise
Body: chat transcript + current outline
Return: validated ResearchBrief JSON

POST /api/agent/start
Body: { brief: ResearchBrief, model: string }
Return: { runId } and begin background execution. Use Server‑Sent Events at:

GET /api/agent/:runId/stream (SSE)
Events: phase, step_start, api_call, artifact, stats, complete, error

POST /api/report/generate
Body: { runId, selection?: string[] }
Return: { markdown, comparisonTable }

3) Schemas (copy these exact fields)
Implement in src/spec/schemas.ts (with Zod for runtime validation):

ResearchBrief:

key_questions: string[]
scope: {

  geography?: string[]
  comparators?: string[]
  domains?: ("clinical"|"policy"|"economics"|"technology"|"other")[]
  population?: string
  outcomes?: string[]
  languages?: string[]
}
deliverable: { format: "report"|"brief"|"bulletin"|"slide"; length: "short"|"standard"|"long"; tone?: "neutral"|"adversarial"|"supportive" }
constraints?: { latency_s?: number; budget_usd?: number; token_cap?: number }
citations_required: boolean
user_notes?: string
ExecutionPlan with:

source_selection: { source_id: string; reason: string }[]
steps: ActionStep[]
evaluation: { success_criteria: string[]; risks: string[] }
ActionStep:

RecordLite, Evidence, ComparisonTable (per names above).

4) Prompts (export constants in src/spec/prompts.ts)
Fill with terse, JSON‑only output instructions. Example seed contents:

INTERVIEW_PROMPT:
“Interview to produce a complete ResearchBrief JSON. Ask only about missing fields, one at a time. After each user reply, output a 4–6 bullet Current Outline. When all fields are specific and falsifiable, output only valid JSON for ResearchBrief—no prose.”

ORCHESTRATOR_PROMPT:
“Given a ResearchBrief and Capabilities, select sources, write exact queries (Boolean for boolean‑capable; natural language for others), and emit an ExecutionPlan with source_selection, steps, evaluation. Include paging, rate‑limit notes, and cost awareness. Output JSON only.”

PUBMED_QUERY_BUILDER_PROMPT:
“Build a PubMed term using [Title/Abstract], [MeSH] when apt, and date [dp]. Expand core synonyms with OR. Output only: { "term":"...", "notes":"..." }.”

WOLFRAM_INPUT_BUILDER_PROMPT:
“Turn a numeric/time‑series question into a WolframAlpha input with explicit region, date range, units, and per‑capita normalisation if relevant. Output only: { "input":"...", "check":["units","dates","region"] }.”

SCREENING_PROMPT:
“Apply inclusion/exclusion rules strictly. Return JSON per record with title/abstract/full‑text decisions and ≤18‑word reason.”

SYNTHESIS_PROMPT:
“Produce a comparison table and a markdown synthesis with inline citations [ShortAuthor Year], sections: Intro, Methods, Findings, Contrasts, Gaps, Implications, ‘What would change the conclusion’. Output markdown only.”

5) Orchestrator heuristics (implement in src/agents/orchestrator.ts)
Map domains → sources:
clinical/biomed → PubMed (+ OpenAlex enrichment);
ML/physics → arXiv;
real‑time numerics → Wolfram;
policy/geopolitics → MediaWiki/gov open data.

If citations_required === true, prefer peer‑reviewed/primary.

Plan steps in this order: PLAN → SEARCH (per source) → FETCH/PARSE → SCREEN (title→abstract→full‑text) → COMPARE (quant + qual) → SYNTHESISE.

Stop when success criteria met or constraints exceeded.

Emit rationale_summary for UI; keep internal notes out of logs.

6) Adapters (HTTP only; no SDK dependencies)
PubMed (src/adapters/pubmed.ts)

ESearch with usehistory=y, pagination retmax, retstart

ESummary for metadata; EFetch for abstracts/full text where available

Respect 3–10 rps (keyed vs unkeyed); backoff on 429

arXiv (src/adapters/arxiv.ts)

Atom API query; start, max_results (≤2000); ≥3‑second delay between calls

Wolfram (src/adapters/wolfram.ts)

Full Results API ?input=...&output=json&appid=...

Handle assumptions and “did you mean” by one automatic refine pass

OpenAlex (src/adapters/openalex.ts)

Enrich with citation counts and venues when possible (optional)

7) Dispatcher & SSE
src/dispatcher.ts:

Accept ExecutionPlan.steps[], run sequentially or with limited concurrency

Emit SSE events from GET /api/agent/:runId/stream

Events: phase, step_start, api_call, artifact, stats, complete, error

8) Screening, metrics, synthesis
src/agents/screening.ts: deterministic rules first; LLM fallback using SCREENING_PROMPT for reason strings.

src/agents/quant.ts:

ini
Copy
Edit
recency = 1/(currentYear - year + 1)
citationScore = ln(citations + 1)
sizeScore = sampleSize / maxSampleSize
overall = 0.35*recency + 0.25*citationScore + 0.25*sizeScore + 0.15*qualityAvg
src/agents/qual.ts: LLM helper rates bias dimensions 1–5 with one‑sentence justification.

src/agents/synthesis.ts: builds ComparisonTable + markdown using SYNTHESIS_PROMPT.

9) LLM interface
src/types/llm.ts:

class LLM { constructor(providerName:string, model:string) {...} }

async generateJSON<T>(prompt: string, schema: z.ZodType<T>, vars?: any): Promise<T>

Add model/provider switch, but implement a Gemini‑only default for the demo.

10) Tests (vitest)
test/plan.spec.ts:

Mocks a ResearchBrief; asserts ExecutionPlan source_selection and steps exist.

test/smoke.spec.ts:

Mocks adapters to return small fixtures; runs dispatcher; expects an SSE complete and a markdown report.

11) README
Include:

pnpm i (or npm i)

cp .env.example .env and set WOLFRAM_APPID

npm run dev to start API on http://localhost:3000

Example curl:

finalise interview → start agent → stream SSE → generate report

Seed content
Use these initial prompt strings inside src/spec/prompts.ts exactly as written above in §4.
Use the schema fields exactly as in §3.
In src/config/capabilities.ts, define capabilities for: pubmed, arxiv, wolfram, openalex, with kind, limits, and requires_key.

Acceptance criteria
npm run dev starts without TypeScript errors.

POST /api/agent/start accepts a valid ResearchBrief and returns { runId }.

GET /api/agent/:runId/stream emits at least phase, step_start, complete.

POST /api/report/generate returns non‑empty { markdown, comparisonTable } (with mocked adapters if no keys).

npm test passes.

Generate all files now following the “Output rules” above.
